fields.Name: T113 - AI Agent Detail
fields.Description: Verifies that opening an individual AI agent renders its configuration/detail view without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Agents section, then click into an individual agent to view its configuration/detail. If a preview appears, use 'Open Full Record' to load the full detail form. Confirm the agent detail view renders. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: An individual AI agent's detail/configuration view is displayed
The detail view shows agent fields or configuration content
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
